verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms GitLab is open source at its core, allowing anyone to run or fork the codebase, which matches the story of reading source under an open license. However, no first-party GitLab documentation is cited that states the specific license or links to the public repository. Missing for 10: official docs citing the open-source license (e.g., MIT) and a direct link to the public GitLab CE/EE source repository.
